reasons: Both answers disclose that they could not search, point to postgresql.org/support/versioning, correctly say 13 reached EOL in November 2025, and give solid 13-to-18 upgrade guidance. B covers the intermediate breaking changes (public schema in 15, scram default in 14) in more depth, but it states that pg_upgrade does not carry over planner statistics, which PostgreSQL 18 changed; A gets that point right, noting only that extended statistics still need ANALYZE. A is also a little tighter and correctly flags the MD5 deprecation, so it edges ahead.

B: Says pg_upgrade does not carry over planner statistics; for a 13-to-18 upgrade, PostgreSQL 18's pg_upgrade preserves most optimizer statistics (extended statistics excepted).
